reporting-org.narrative: Norad - Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation

description.narrative: Norad supports ENGIE Afrique in financing the training programme for their solar home system sales and installation agents across its African markets. This allows them to better assess potential customers and ensure that they have the capacity to keep paying for the equipment before installation, ultimately ensuring increased use. It also helps prevent unnecessary waste where customers stop using and potentially damage equipment, or doubling up with new kits when they default on payments for the first one. Overall it contributes to a more professional market for solar home systems.
